snippet.title: Zafe's Adventures - SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Just done working on my demo of my passion game project for SAGE 2025, this does have lot of improvements and enhancements for this new demo, I'm so excited to have anyone enjoy it on SAGE 2025.

Demo available September 19.

Play the previous demos here:
GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/zafeadventures/838455
Itch.io: https://tuanbaodoratom.itch.io/zafes-adventures

Note: I'm sorry about being too inactive on my channel, been busy working on some stuff like my work on my own game lately and I've been coping up with some issues I've went into. So anyway, my game that I working on was a little bit rushed but at least I'm fine with it.

Music: Autism Island III
Music obtained from The Mod Archive.

TuanBaoDoratom
2025
